features: Registered real SPHEREx A/B/quality/evidence/restore for 10 targets.
Separate epsilonIndiBa/Bb actual Gemini photo and sourced literature detail outside the 1000 AU scene.
Semantic TOP5 region cards with original rows and persistent actual-TNO browsing.
Source-centred zoom-out navigation markers; source-pinned native small-body past/future origins.
2026 SNHS Alpha credits, public repository/attributions and complete downloadable Data Spec PDF.
Normal-flow scrollable intro card without obscuring the exploration text.

PDF.screen_scope: all 380 pages rasterized/contact sheets plus independent representative full pages; final changed opening page inspected

release_metadata.meaning: actual release source freeze UTC; distinct from PDF build time

limits: Node serves source-verified build caches; not arbitrary on-demand FITS analysis.
SOURCE/coverage/finite pixels do not establish a detection, motion or flux.
TOP5 is conditional 2018 literature sky-position regions, not existence probability or discovered planet candidates.
Two-body long-range display and optional restricted gravity do not implement all physics or verified historical reconstruction.
No native-speaker review for Japanese, Traditional Chinese or French; CSS125% is not browser-toolbar zoom.
No new release ZIP, no old FITS/evidence/release mutation, no private keys/research papers/internal documents in public source.
